agavoni.ingredients: Reposado tequila 30 ml; Campari 30 ml; Sweet vermouth 30 ml; Orange bitters 1 dash
agavoni.difference: With tequila: herbal, peppery agave notes against Campari's bitterness.

alexander_gin.ingredients: London Dry gin 30 ml; White crème de cacao 30 ml; Cream 30 ml
alexander_gin.difference: The original early 20th-century Alexander: gin instead of cognac and white crème de cacao, making it drier and lighter.

alien_brain_hemorrhage.ingredients: Peach schnapps 20 ml; Irish cream liqueur (Baileys) 5 ml; Blue curaçao 3 drops; Grenadine 3 drops
alien_brain_hemorrhage.difference: A drop of blue curaçao turns the "brain" green-blue, like an alien's.

amaretto_sour_classic.ingredients: Amaretto 60 ml; Lemon juice 30 ml; Simple syrup 10 ml
amaretto_sour_classic.difference: No bourbon or egg white: simpler and sweeter, as in the 1970s.

aperol_spritz_white_wine.ingredients: Dry white wine 90 ml; Aperol 60 ml; Club soda 60 ml
aperol_spritz_white_wine.difference: As served in Veneto bars: still white wine instead of prosecco, drier, with no bubbles from the wine.

b52_flaming.ingredients: Coffee liqueur 20 ml; Irish cream liqueur (Baileys) 20 ml; Orange liqueur (Grand Marnier) 15 ml; Overproof rum (float) 5 ml
b52_flaming.difference: The top layer (with a splash of overproof rum) is set alight and drunk quickly through a straw from the bottom. Requires care.

b55.ingredients: Coffee liqueur 20 ml; Irish cream liqueur (Baileys) 20 ml; Absinthe 20 ml
b55.difference: The top orange liqueur layer is replaced with absinthe: stronger and more anise-forward; usually served flaming.

baileys_coffee.ingredients: Irish cream liqueur (Baileys) 45 ml; Hot coffee 150 ml; Whipped cream (optional) — on top
baileys_coffee.difference: The simplest and sweetest home variation, with no sugar or whiskey.

banana_daiquiri.ingredients: White rum 50 ml; Banana liqueur 15 ml; Banana 0.5 pc; Lime juice 20 ml; Simple syrup 10 ml
banana_daiquiri.difference: With banana and banana liqueur, blended with ice: dessert-like, with a creamy texture.

bandera_mezcal.ingredients: Lime juice 30 ml; Mezcal 30 ml; Sangrita 30 ml; Orange slice with worm salt (sal de gusano) 1 pc
bandera_mezcal.difference: In Oaxaca, mezcal is served with orange slices and salt made with chili and worms; the smoky flavor pairs well with sangrita.

bay_breeze.ingredients: Vodka 40 ml; Cranberry juice 90 ml; Pineapple juice 60 ml
bay_breeze.difference: Grapefruit is replaced with pineapple: sweeter and more tropical.

bloody_caesar.ingredients: Vodka 45 ml; Clamato (tomato and clam juice) 120 ml; Worcestershire sauce 2 dash; Tabasco 2 dash; Lime juice 10 ml; Celery salt (rim) — to taste
bloody_caesar.difference: Canada's national version (Walter Chell, Calgary, 1969), made with Clamato tomato-clam juice.

bloody_maria.ingredients: Blanco tequila 45 ml; Tomato juice 90 ml; Lime juice 15 ml; Worcestershire sauce 2 dash; Hot sauce 2 dash; Salt, pepper — to taste
bloody_maria.difference: Tequila instead of vodka and lime instead of lemon: more herbal and spicier.

blue_margarita.ingredients: Blanco tequila 50 ml; Blue curaçao 20 ml; Lime juice 20 ml
blue_margarita.difference: Triple sec is replaced with blue curaçao: same flavor, bright blue color.

boston_sour.ingredients: Bourbon 45 ml; Lemon juice 25 ml; Simple syrup 20 ml; Egg white 20 ml
boston_sour.difference: Egg white is mandatory: this is what old books called a Whiskey Sour with egg white, and today it's the standard bar version.

bourbon_manhattan.ingredients: Bourbon 50 ml; Sweet vermouth 20 ml; Angostura bitters 2 dash
bourbon_manhattan.difference: The most common bar version: bourbon instead of rye gives a sweeter, softer, more vanilla-forward drink.

brandy_sour.ingredients: Brandy 50 ml; Lemon juice 25 ml; Simple syrup 15 ml; Angostura bitters 2 dash
brandy_sour.difference: A Cypriot national classic (often with brandy, lemon cordial and soda): fruitier and softer.

bucks_fizz.difference: The British version (Buck's Club, 1921) with twice the Champagne.

cadillac_margarita.ingredients: Reposado tequila 50 ml; Grand Marnier 20 ml; Lime juice 20 ml; Agave syrup (optional) 5 ml
cadillac_margarita.difference: The "premium" version: aged tequila and cognac-based Grand Marnier instead of triple sec.

caipirinha_fruit.ingredients: Cachaça 60 ml; Lime 0.25 pc; Fruit (passion fruit, strawberry, kiwi) — to taste; Cane sugar 2 tsp
caipirinha_fruit.difference: A Brazilian street version where seasonal fruit is muddled along with, or instead of, the lime.

caipirissima.ingredients: White rum 60 ml; Lime 0.5 pc; Cane sugar 2 tsp
caipirissima.difference: White rum instead of cachaça: closer to a Daiquiri in flavor.

caipiroska.ingredients: Vodka 60 ml; Lime 0.5 pc; Cane sugar 2 tsp
caipiroska.difference: Cachaça is replaced with vodka: cleaner and more neutral; very popular in Europe and Russia.

campari_spritz.ingredients: Prosecco 90 ml; Campari 60 ml; Club soda 30 ml
campari_spritz.difference: Campari instead of Aperol: more bitter, drier, bright red, and its aperitivo is almost twice as strong.

cardinal.ingredients: Crème de cassis 15 ml; Red wine (Beaujolais) 90 ml
cardinal.difference: With red wine: darker and richer.

chelada.ingredients: Light beer (lager) 330 ml; Lime juice 30 ml; Salt for the rim — to taste
chelada.difference: The simplest version: just beer, lime and salt, no sauces.

chi_chi.ingredients: Vodka 45 ml; Coconut cream 30 ml; Pineapple juice 90 ml
chi_chi.difference: Rum is replaced with vodka: more neutral, letting coconut and pineapple take center stage. A 1950s Hawaiian bar classic.

chuhai_grapefruit.ingredients: Shochu 45 ml; Fresh grapefruit juice 60 ml; Sparkling water 100 ml
chuhai_grapefruit.difference: The second most popular chuhai; in izakayas the grapefruit is often squeezed right at the table.

colorado_bulldog.ingredients: Vodka 30 ml; Coffee liqueur 30 ml; Cream 30 ml; Cola 60 ml
colorado_bulldog.difference: A White Russian topped with cola: foamy, sweet and lighter.

cuba_libre_dark.ingredients: Dark or spiced rum 50 ml; Cola 120 ml; Lime juice 10 ml
cuba_libre_dark.difference: Dark or spiced rum gives a richer caramel-vanilla flavor.

daiquiri_no4.ingredients: White rum 60 ml; Lime juice 20 ml; Simple syrup 10 ml; Maraschino liqueur 1 bsp
daiquiri_no4.difference: Constantino Ribalaigua's El Floridita version with a touch of maraschino, blended with fine ice.

dark_n_stormy_spiced.ingredients: Spiced rum 50 ml; Ginger beer 120 ml; Lime juice 15 ml; Angostura bitters 2 dash
dark_n_stormy_spiced.difference: An unofficial bar version with spiced rum, lime and bitters: more spice, less sweetness.

diabolo_grenadine.difference: With pomegranate syrup: red and fruity.

diamond_fizz.ingredients: London Dry gin 45 ml; Lemon juice 30 ml; Simple syrup 15 ml; Champagne 60 ml
diamond_fizz.difference: Club soda is replaced with Champagne: essentially a French 75 in a tall glass.

dirty_martini.ingredients: Gin or vodka 60 ml; Dry vermouth 10 ml; Olive brine 15 ml
dirty_martini.difference: Olive brine is added, making the drink cloudy and salty. Popular since the 1990s.

dirty_shirley.ingredients: Vodka 45 ml; Lemon-lime soda (Sprite) 150 ml; Grenadine 15 ml
dirty_shirley.difference: The alcoholic version with vodka, which went viral in the 2020s.

dry_manhattan.ingredients: Rye whiskey 50 ml; Dry vermouth 20 ml; Angostura bitters 1 dash
dry_manhattan.difference: Dry vermouth only: the driest, spiciest take on the Manhattan.

espresso_martini_tequila.ingredients: Reposado tequila or aged rum 45 ml; Coffee liqueur 15 ml; Fresh espresso 30 ml; Simple syrup 10 ml
espresso_martini_tequila.difference: A modern bar variation: an aged spirit instead of vodka adds vanilla and caramel.

fifty_fifty_martini.ingredients: London Dry gin 40 ml; Dry vermouth 40 ml; Orange bitters 1 dash
fifty_fifty_martini.difference: Equal parts gin and vermouth, as in the early 20th century: softer, more aromatic and lighter. Revived by cocktail renaissance bars.

four_horsemen.ingredients: Tennessee whiskey 10 ml; Scotch 10 ml; Bourbon 10 ml; Tequila (Jose Cuervo) 10 ml
four_horsemen.difference: Jose Cuervo tequila is added to the Three Wise Men as the fourth "horseman".

french_75_cognac.ingredients: Cognac 30 ml; Lemon juice 15 ml; Simple syrup 15 ml; Champagne 60 ml
french_75_cognac.difference: The New Orleans version (Arnaud's French 75 Bar): cognac instead of gin, warmer and fruitier.

frozen_daiquiri.ingredients: White rum 60 ml; Lime juice 25 ml; Simple syrup 20 ml; Crushed ice 1 cup
frozen_daiquiri.difference: Blended with ice to a sorbet-like consistency; a serve made famous by El Floridita. More sugar, since cold dulls sweetness.

frozen_grasshopper.ingredients: Green crème de menthe 30 ml; White crème de cacao 30 ml; Vanilla ice cream 2 scoops
frozen_grasshopper.difference: Cream is replaced with ice cream and everything is blended, the way it's drunk in the US Midwest.

frozen_margarita.ingredients: Blanco tequila 50 ml; Triple sec 20 ml; Lime juice 25 ml; Simple syrup 15 ml; Crushed ice 1 cup
frozen_margarita.difference: Blended with ice. The frozen margarita machine was invented by Mariano Martinez in Dallas in 1971.

georgia_mint_julep.ingredients: Cognac 45 ml; Peach brandy (liqueur) 15 ml; Simple syrup 10 ml; Mint leaves 8 pc
georgia_mint_julep.difference: Antebellum 19th-century version: bourbon is replaced with cognac and peach brandy, making it fruitier and softer.

gibson.ingredients: London Dry gin 60 ml; Dry vermouth 10 ml
gibson.difference: The same Dry Martini, but with a pickled onion instead of an olive, giving a savory, slightly sour note. By one account, named after illustrator Charles Dana Gibson.

gimlet_cordial.ingredients: London Dry gin 60 ml; Lime cordial (Rose's) 30 ml
gimlet_cordial.difference: The historical 2:1 formula with preserved lime cordial: sweeter and more candy-like than the fresh version.

gin_sour.ingredients: London Dry gin 50 ml; Lemon juice 25 ml; Simple syrup 20 ml; Egg white (optional) 20 ml
gin_sour.difference: The same formula with gin: more herbal and lighter.

gintonic_spanish.ingredients: Gin 50 ml; Premium tonic 200 ml; Botanical garnish (juniper, citrus peel, pepper, herbs) — to taste
gintonic_spanish.difference: Spanish-style serve: a huge balloon glass, lots of ice, premium tonic and a garnish that highlights the botanicals of the specific gin.

glogg.ingredients: Red wine 150 ml; Vodka or port 30 ml; Sugar 15 ml; Spices (cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, citrus peel) — to taste; Raisins and almonds — to taste
glogg.difference: The Scandinavian version: stronger thanks to vodka or port, served with raisins and almonds.
glogg.garnish: raisins and almonds in the mug

godchild.ingredients: Vodka 30 ml; Amaretto 30 ml; Cream 30 ml
godchild.difference: A creamy dessert version made with vodka.

godmother.difference: Scotch is replaced with vodka: more neutral, letting the amaretto's almond take center stage.

golden_fizz.ingredients: London Dry gin 45 ml; Lemon juice 30 ml; Simple syrup 15 ml; Egg yolk 1 pc; Club soda 60 ml
golden_fizz.difference: With egg yolk: a golden color and a richer, creamier taste.

hot_toddy_tea.ingredients: Whiskey 50 ml; Honey 15 ml; Lemon juice 15 ml; Hot black tea 120 ml
hot_toddy_tea.difference: Brewed tea instead of hot water adds astringency and tannins.

irish_mule.ingredients: Irish whiskey 45 ml; Ginger beer 120 ml; Lime juice 10 ml
irish_mule.difference: With Irish whiskey: a soft, malty flavor.

jamaican_coffee.ingredients: Dark rum 30 ml; Coffee liqueur 20 ml; Hot coffee 120 ml; Whipped cream — on top
jamaican_coffee.difference: Whiskey is replaced with rum and coffee liqueur: sweeter and more tropical.

john_collins_whiskey.ingredients: Bourbon 45 ml; Lemon juice 30 ml; Simple syrup 15 ml; Club soda 60 ml
john_collins_whiskey.difference: In the US, the bourbon version is often called a John Collins (the IBA uses gin).

john_daly.ingredients: Vodka 45 ml; Iced tea 90 ml; Lemonade 90 ml
john_daly.difference: A "grown-up" Arnold Palmer with vodka, named after golfer John Daly.

jote.ingredients: Red wine (usually boxed) 100 ml; Cola 100 ml
jote.difference: The Chilean name for the same wine-and-cola combination; a student and party classic in Chile.

juan_collins.ingredients: Blanco tequila 45 ml; Lemon juice 30 ml; Agave syrup 15 ml; Club soda 60 ml
juan_collins.difference: A Mexican version with tequila and agave.

kalashnikov_mix.ingredients: Citrus vodka 30 ml; Lemon juice 10 ml; Coffee liqueur 10 ml
kalashnikov_mix.difference: Bar version: everything shaken into one shot; easier to drink, but you lose the contrast of the chaser.

kingston_negroni.ingredients: Jamaican rum 30 ml; Campari 30 ml; Sweet vermouth 30 ml
kingston_negroni.difference: Made with Jamaican rum (Joey Goldstein, 2010s): the rum's fruity, funky notes play against Campari's bitterness.

kir.ingredients: Crème de cassis 15 ml; Aligoté white wine 90 ml
kir.difference: The original Burgundian version with still Aligoté white wine.

kir_imperial.ingredients: Raspberry liqueur (crème de framboise or Chambord) 15 ml; Champagne 90 ml

london_mule.ingredients: London Dry gin 45 ml; Ginger beer 120 ml; Lime juice 10 ml
london_mule.difference: With gin: more herbal; historically this highball was called a Gin Buck.

long_beach_iced_tea.ingredients: Vodka 15 ml; Gin 15 ml; White rum 15 ml; Tequila 15 ml; Triple sec 15 ml; Lemon juice 25 ml; Simple syrup 15 ml; Cranberry juice — top up
long_beach_iced_tea.difference: Cola is replaced with cranberry juice: pink and tart-berry.

mai_tai_royal_hawaiian.ingredients: White rum 30 ml; Dark rum (float) 30 ml; Orange curaçao 15 ml; Orgeat 15 ml; Lime juice 22.5 ml; Pineapple juice 60 ml; Orange juice 30 ml
mai_tai_royal_hawaiian.difference: The resort version Trader Vic adapted for Hawaiian hotels: with pineapple and orange juices, it's sweeter, lighter and more beachy than the original.

mexican_55.ingredients: Reposado tequila 30 ml; Lemon juice 15 ml; Simple syrup 15 ml; Champagne 60 ml
mexican_55.difference: A French 75 with tequila: herbal and spicy.

mexican_mule.ingredients: Blanco tequila 45 ml; Ginger beer 120 ml; Lime juice 15 ml
mexican_mule.difference: With tequila: herbal agave notes plus ginger.

mezcal_margarita.ingredients: Mezcal 50 ml; Triple sec 20 ml; Lime juice 20 ml
mezcal_margarita.difference: Mezcal instead of tequila: a smoky margarita; tequila and mezcal are often split 50/50.
mezcal_margarita.garnish: worm salt (sal de gusano) rim, lime

mezcal_negroni.ingredients: Mezcal 30 ml; Campari 30 ml; Sweet vermouth 30 ml
mezcal_negroni.difference: Gin is replaced with mezcal, adding a smoky note. One of the most popular modern variations.

michelada_clamato.ingredients: Light beer (lager) 250 ml; Clamato 90 ml; Lime juice 30 ml; Worcestershire and hot sauce 2 dash; Chili salt for the rim — to taste
michelada_clamato.difference: With Clamato tomato-clam juice: popular in northern Mexico and the US; closer to a Bloody Mary.

mint_lemonade.ingredients: Lemon juice 45 ml; Simple syrup 30 ml; Mint leaves 10 pc; Club soda 150 ml
mint_lemonade.difference: With muddled mint; the basic "lemonade" at many Russian cafés.

negroni_on_tap.ingredients: London Dry gin 45 ml; Campari 22.5 ml; Sweet vermouth 22.5 ml
negroni_on_tap.difference: A bartender-favorite ratio with double the gin: drier and less sweet than 1:1:1.

non_alc_mulled.ingredients: Red grape or cherry juice 200 ml; Orange (slices) 2 pc; Cinnamon, cloves, star anise — to taste; Lemon juice 10 ml
non_alc_mulled.difference: Made with grape (or cherry/cranberry) juice; honey usually isn't needed since the juice is already sweet.

old_fashioned_muddled.ingredients: Brandy or bourbon 45 ml; Sugar cube 1 pc; Angostura bitters 3 dash; Orange slice 1 pc; Cocktail cherry 1 pc; Lemon-lime soda or club soda 60 ml
old_fashioned_muddled.difference: Post-war American version: the orange and cherry are muddled with sugar and topped with lemon-lime soda or club soda. In Wisconsin it's traditionally made with brandy.

orgasm_shot.ingredients: Amaretto 15 ml; Coffee liqueur 15 ml; Irish cream liqueur (Baileys) 15 ml

paloma_fresh.ingredients: Blanco tequila 50 ml; Fresh grapefruit juice 60 ml; Lime juice 15 ml; Agave syrup 10 ml; Club soda 60 ml; Salt 1 pinch
paloma_fresh.difference: A bar version without ready-made grapefruit soda: fresh juice, agave syrup and club soda make it drier and brighter.

penicillin_bourbon.ingredients: Bourbon 60 ml; Lemon juice 22.5 ml; Honey-ginger syrup 22.5 ml; Peated Islay Scotch 7.5 ml
penicillin_bourbon.difference: A common bar swap of blended Scotch for bourbon: sweeter with more vanilla, and the smoke comes only from the float.

perfect_manhattan.ingredients: Rye whiskey 50 ml; Sweet vermouth 10 ml; Dry vermouth 10 ml; Angostura bitters 1 dash
perfect_manhattan.difference: The vermouth is split equally between sweet and dry, making it drier and lighter than the classic. Usually garnished with a twist instead of a cherry.

perfect_martini.ingredients: London Dry gin 60 ml; Dry vermouth 7.5 ml; Sweet vermouth 7.5 ml
perfect_martini.difference: Equal parts dry and sweet vermouth for a rounder flavor.

perfect_rob_roy.ingredients: Blended Scotch 50 ml; Sweet vermouth 12.5 ml; Dry vermouth 12.5 ml; Angostura bitters 1 dash
perfect_rob_roy.difference: Like the Perfect Manhattan, it splits the two vermouths equally; this is the version preferred in Scotland.

perroquet.ingredients: Pastis 30 ml; Mint syrup 15 ml; Cold water 150 ml
perroquet.difference: With mint syrup: a bright green "parrot".

pisco_sour_chilean.ingredients: Chilean pisco 60 ml; Lemon juice (pica) 30 ml; Powdered sugar 2 tsp
pisco_sour_chilean.difference: The Chilean version: lemon instead of lime, usually without egg white or bitters.

raspberry_lime_rickey.ingredients: Lime juice 30 ml; Raspberry syrup 22.5 ml; Club soda 150 ml
raspberry_lime_rickey.difference: A New England classic with raspberry syrup: pink and berry-forward.

red_snapper.ingredients: London Dry gin 45 ml; Tomato juice 90 ml; Lemon juice 15 ml; Worcestershire sauce 2 dash; Tabasco 1 dash; Salt, pepper — to taste
red_snapper.difference: Made with gin. In the 1930s at the St. Regis, Petiot's drink was for a time served as the Red Snapper because "Bloody Mary" seemed indecent; today the name refers specifically to the gin version.

rourou.ingredients: Pastis 30 ml; Strawberry syrup 15 ml; Cold water 150 ml
rourou.difference: Rourou is pastis with strawberry syrup, another member of the "syrup" family alongside the Mauresque, Perroquet and Tomate.

roy_rogers.difference: Ginger ale is replaced with cola; named after the cowboy film star.

royal_fizz.ingredients: London Dry gin 45 ml; Lemon juice 30 ml; Simple syrup 15 ml; Whole egg 1 pc; Club soda 60 ml
royal_fizz.difference: With a whole egg: the richest of the fizzes.

royal_mojito.ingredients: White rum 45 ml; Lime juice 20 ml; Cane sugar 2 tsp; Mint leaves 6 pc; Champagne 60 ml
royal_mojito.difference: Club soda is replaced with Champagne: a festive version.

rum_old_fashioned.ingredients: Aged rum 60 ml; Demerara syrup 7.5 ml; Angostura bitters 2 dash
rum_old_fashioned.difference: Whiskey is swapped for aged rum and sugar for demerara cane syrup: more caramel and tropical fruit.

rum_sour.ingredients: Aged rum 50 ml; Lime juice 25 ml; Demerara syrup 20 ml; Egg white (optional) 20 ml
rum_sour.difference: Aged rum with lime and cane syrup: more caramel.

sambuca_flambe.difference: The sambuca is lit in a snifter, which is then covered with a palm to put out the flame and create a vacuum; you drink it and inhale the vapors through a straw.

sangria_blanca.ingredients: Dry white wine 150 ml; Brandy or peach liqueur 20 ml; Peach, apple, citrus (sliced) — to taste; Simple syrup 10 ml; Club soda 30 ml
sangria_blanca.difference: White wine with peaches and citrus: lighter and fresher.

sangria_cava.ingredients: Cava (Spanish sparkling wine) 150 ml; Orange liqueur 15 ml; Berries and citrus — to taste
sangria_cava.difference: A Catalan sparkling version made with cava.

sazerac_cognac.ingredients: Cognac 60 ml; Absinthe (rinse) 5 ml; Sugar cube 1 pc; Peychaud's bitters 3 dash
sazerac_cognac.difference: The historically original cognac version: softer, fruitier and less spicy than with rye. Often made 50/50 cognac and rye.

sbagliato_bianco.ingredients: Bitter bianco 30 ml; Blanc vermouth 30 ml; Prosecco 30 ml
sbagliato_bianco.difference: A pale version with bitter bianco and blanc vermouth: more floral and softer.

sbiten_hmelnoy.ingredients: Water 150 ml; Honey 30 ml; Spices — to taste; Red wine or mead 60 ml
sbiten_hmelnoy.difference: The historical "boozy" version with wine or mead.

scotch_sour.ingredients: Blended Scotch 50 ml; Lemon juice 25 ml; Honey syrup 20 ml; Egg white (optional) 20 ml
scotch_sour.difference: Scotch with honey: a malty, slightly smoky version.

select_spritz.ingredients: Prosecco 90 ml; Select Aperitivo 60 ml; Club soda 30 ml
select_spritz.difference: The Venetian version with the local Select bitter, traditionally served with a green olive on a pick.

shandy.ingredients: Light beer 250 ml; Lemonade (British, carbonated) 250 ml
shandy.difference: The British and French sibling of the radler; in Britain it's often made with ginger beer (ginger shandy).

silver_fizz.ingredients: London Dry gin 45 ml; Lemon juice 30 ml; Simple syrup 15 ml; Egg white 20 ml; Club soda 60 ml
silver_fizz.difference: With egg white: a fluffy foam and silky texture.

spicy_margarita.ingredients: Blanco tequila (or jalapeño-infused) 50 ml; Triple sec or agave syrup 15 ml; Lime juice 25 ml; Jalapeño (slices) 2 pc
spicy_margarita.difference: With jalapeño (muddled or infused) and chili salt. One of the most-ordered margaritas of the 2020s.

straits_sling.ingredients: London Dry gin 60 ml; Cherry brandy (cherry liqueur) 15 ml; Bénédictine 15 ml; Lemon juice 22.5 ml; Angostura bitters 2 dash; Orange bitters 2 dash; Club soda 60 ml
straits_sling.difference: A reconstruction of the early version without pineapple and grenadine: drier, cherry-herbal, with club soda. Many historians consider it closer to the original.

strawberry_daiquiri.ingredients: White rum 50 ml; Lime juice 20 ml; Simple syrup 15 ml; Strawberries 5 pc
strawberry_daiquiri.difference: With strawberries (muddled or blended): a sweet, berry-forward and very popular resort version.

strawberry_margarita.ingredients: Blanco tequila 45 ml; Triple sec 15 ml; Lime juice 20 ml; Strawberries 5 pc; Simple syrup 10 ml
strawberry_margarita.difference: With strawberries, usually served frozen: a sweet berry version.

strawberry_mojito.ingredients: White rum 45 ml; Lime juice 20 ml; Cane sugar 2 tsp; Mint leaves 6 pc; Strawberries 3 pc; Club soda 60 ml
strawberry_mojito.difference: Strawberries are muddled with the mint for a sweet berry version. The same works with raspberry, passion fruit or watermelon.

tarkhun_cocktail.ingredients: Gin or vodka 45 ml; Fresh tarragon 4 sprigs; Lemon juice 22.5 ml; Simple syrup 22.5 ml; Club soda 90 ml
tarkhun_cocktail.difference: An alcoholic take on tarragon soda, similar in spirit to the Gin Basil Smash.

tequila_orange_cinnamon.ingredients: Tequila (gold or reposado) 40 ml; Orange slice 1 pc; Ground cinnamon — to taste
tequila_orange_cinnamon.difference: A serve popular in bars in Russia and Eastern Europe: instead of salt and lime, an orange slice dusted with cinnamon; it suits aged tequila better.

tequila_sour.ingredients: Blanco tequila 50 ml; Lime juice 25 ml; Agave syrup 15 ml; Egg white 20 ml
tequila_sour.difference: Tequila with agave and lime: herbal and fresh.

tequila_sunrise_biltmore.ingredients: Blanco tequila 45 ml; Crème de cassis 15 ml; Lime juice 15 ml; Club soda 90 ml
tequila_sunrise_biltmore.difference: The original Arizona Biltmore version: lime, blackcurrant cassis and club soda instead of orange juice and grenadine.

tintoretto.difference: With pomegranate juice: tart-sweet and ruby red.

tokyo_tea.ingredients: Vodka 15 ml; Gin 15 ml; White rum 15 ml; Tequila 15 ml; Triple sec 15 ml; Melon liqueur (Midori) 15 ml; Lemon juice 25 ml; Lemon-lime soda — top up
tokyo_tea.difference: Midori and lemon-lime soda instead of cola: bright green.

tom_and_jerry.ingredients: Dark rum 30 ml; Cognac 30 ml; Egg batter (eggs beaten with sugar and spices) 2 tbsp; Hot milk 120 ml
tom_and_jerry.difference: A hot 19th-century eggnog (Pierce Egan, 1820s): the whipped egg "batter" is topped with hot milk and spirits.

tomate.ingredients: Pastis 30 ml; Grenadine 15 ml; Cold water 150 ml
tomate.difference: With grenadine: red, fruity and anise-flavored.

vesper_cocchi.ingredients: London Dry gin 45 ml; Vodka 15 ml; Cocchi Americano 7.5 ml
vesper_cocchi.difference: Cocchi Americano, with its quinine, is closer in bitterness to the discontinued Kina Lillet from Fleming's original recipe.

virgin_colada.ingredients: Coconut cream 45 ml; Pineapple juice 90 ml; Lime juice 10 ml
virgin_colada.difference: No rum and a bit more juice: a popular non-alcoholic version.

virgin_mary.ingredients: Tomato juice 150 ml; Lemon juice 15 ml; Worcestershire sauce 2 dash; Tabasco 1 dash; Salt, pepper — to taste
virgin_mary.difference: No vodka: a non-alcoholic brunch classic.

virgin_mojito.ingredients: Lime juice 25 ml; Cane sugar 2 tsp; Mint leaves 8 pc; Club soda or Sprite 150 ml
virgin_mojito.difference: No rum: more soda and lime; the best-selling mocktail in the world.

vodka_collins.ingredients: Vodka 45 ml; Lemon juice 30 ml; Simple syrup 15 ml; Club soda 60 ml
vodka_collins.difference: Vodka instead of gin: a neutral lemonade without herbal notes.

vodka_gimlet.ingredients: Vodka 60 ml; Lime juice 20 ml; Simple syrup 15 ml
vodka_gimlet.difference: With vodka: neutral and as lime-forward as it gets; popular since the 1950s–60s.

vodka_martini.difference: Gin is replaced with vodka: cleaner and more neutral; this is the "shaken, not stirred" drink Bond orders in the films.

whiskey_sour_no_egg.ingredients: Bourbon 60 ml; Lemon juice 22.5 ml; Simple syrup 22.5 ml
whiskey_sour_no_egg.difference: The original 19th-century version without egg white: lighter, tarter and drier; vegan-friendly.

white_cosmo.ingredients: Citrus vodka 40 ml; Cointreau 15 ml; White cranberry juice 30 ml; Lime juice 15 ml
white_cosmo.difference: With white cranberry juice: clear and slightly less tart; often served with frozen berries.

white_mulled_wine.ingredients: Dry white wine 200 ml; Honey 15 ml; Orange and lemon (slices) 2 pc; Cinnamon, cardamom, star anise — to taste; Ginger (slices) 2 pc
white_mulled_wine.difference: With white wine: lighter, paler and more citrusy; cardamom and ginger work best.

white_russian_oat.ingredients: Vodka 50 ml; Coffee liqueur 20 ml; Oat milk (barista) 40 ml
white_russian_oat.difference: Cream is replaced with oat milk: lighter and vegan-friendly.
